steps.name: Set up job
Checkout repository
Install Linux headless Qt runtime libraries
Set up Python 3.11 (3.11.9 on Windows; 3.11.18 on Ubuntu 26.04)
Install hashed lockfile dependencies
Ruff lint and format check
Pyflakes check
Gate G1 architecture, integrity, and traceability checks
Gate G1 Alembic reversible migration cycle
Gate G1 unit tests (gates + DB config)
Gate G4 independent sub-gates (G4a, G4b, G4c) and R reference staleness gate
Gate G5 F1..F10 models, clustering isolation, and 1M-row benchmark
Gate G6 validation, portfolio, 13-criteria scoring, Top-5, and baseline lock
Gate G7 UQ, drift, reporting, causal M&V and monitoring integrity
Full test suite and coverage gate (S5 >= 60%, Core + TestsCatalog + Mining + Models + Validation + Scoring + Lock >= 80%)
Emit pytest failure annotations on error
GUI smoke, Phase 1..5 shell, schema, VSG/TCP & 1M table tests (GUI >= 56%)
Phase 1 Windows packaging & runtime evidence (CI, non-normative per D2)
Self-signed Authenticode signing smoke test (D1=B, Windows)
Vulnerability audit (pip-audit)
Generate CycloneDX SBOM
Upload SBOM, coverage, and Phase 1 evidence artifacts
Post Set up Python 3.11 (3.11.9 on Windows; 3.11.18 on Ubuntu 26.04)
Post Checkout repository
Complete job
